drifted.spec_text: The component initialization stack is: SPDK environment init, GPU services init, dispatch map init (ephemeral, no persistence), memory-tier init with CUDA host registration, then dispatcher init with data PCI addresses.
drifted.actual: Init order also creates and binds an EvictionPolicyLru component (shared by dispatch-map and memory-tier) and a RemoteLookup component (bound to the dispatcher). Neither is mentioned in the FR-008 stack description or the 'Component Stack' section.

drifted.spec_text: Implementation Details for FR-010 document the Python test client CLI as `test_client.py [--server ADDRESS:PORT] [--skip-tests] [--benchmark]` with a 9-case functional suite (test_populate, test_populate_duplicate_key, test_populate_already_exists, test_check, test_lookup, test_lookup_not_found, test_remove, test_remove_not_found, test_touch) and exit codes 0/1/2/3 (3 = connection error).
drifted.actual: Actual CLI flags are `--server`, `--skip-large-batch`, `--bench`, `--bench-only`, `--bench-object-size`, `--bench-num-objects`, `--bench-iterations` (no `--skip-tests` or `--benchmark`). The suite has 10 differently-named functions (test_batch_populate, test_batch_check, test_batch_touch, test_batch_lookup, test_batch_remove, test_check_after_remove, test_duplicate_key_rejection, test_nonexistent_key_handling, test_touch_nonexistent, test_large_batch); there is no test_populate_already_exists / AlreadyExists case. Only sys.exit(0)/sys.exit(1) are used; no distinct exit codes 2 or 3.

drifted.spec_text: The IPC handle in the gRPC protocol MUST be represented as a serializable structure containing: (1) cuda_ipc_handle (bytes), (2) size (uint32), (3) gpu_device_id (int32).
drifted.actual: The `IpcHandle` proto message also defines a 4th field, `offset` (uint64), used throughout service.rs to address a sub-block within a shared allocation (`dev_ptr + offset`). This field is functionally load-bearing but is not part of the FR-011 field list.

drifted.spec_text: Pending stores are tracked per-reservation in a `PendingStores` map keyed by a server-assigned reservation ID (`u64`).
drifted.actual: `PendingStores` (`HashMap<u64, PendingStoreEntry>`) is keyed by the client-supplied cache key from `ReserveEntry.key`, not a server-generated reservation ID. `CommitStore`/`AbortStore` proto messages also take `keys` (cache keys); there is no reservation-ID allocation anywhere in the service.

conflicts.description: README.md's 'Component Stack' section and architecture diagram describe a metadata NVMe device plus an IExtentManager persistence layer backing the dispatch map, and its gRPC API table lists only 4 of the 15 defined RPCs (missing Touch, Reserve, CopyToStore, CommitStore, AbortStore, ClearMemoryTier, FlushToSsd, Pin, Unpin, TakeEvents, GetIoStats). Its CLI Options table also omits --drive-count, --format, --memory-tier-size, --poller-base-cpu, --max-eviction-attempts, --memory-tier-eviction-threshold, --otel-endpoint, --otel-service-name. This contradicts spec 002's explicit clarification that there is no metadata device and no extent-manager-backed persistence, and understates the current implementation.
